item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 01/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be rather cool and windy over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend. Besides, a band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the region tomorrow. Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will improve over southern China on Sunday. It will be fine and dry in the following few days with temperatures rising gradually.

Date/Month: 02/04 (Saturday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Rather cool in the morning. Cloudy to overcast with a few rain patches.
Temp range: 13 - 16 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
